project_type: Full-stack medical SaaS — Django REST API backend + React SPA frontend
build_system: Backend: Django manage.py (plain Python, .venv at d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend\.venv). Frontend: Vite 8 (npm scripts in package.json). No monorepo tooling.
test_framework: No automated test suite in repo. Verification is: (1) Django check/migrate, (2) Vite build, (3) manual smoke.
test_command: Backend check: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1
verification_instructions:
1. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations 2>&1
2. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate 2>&1
3. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1
4. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\eslint src --ext .jsx,.js --max-warnings=0 2>&1
5. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Python venv at backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe. Recharts is NOT installed (not in package.json) — use pure SVG for charts. No Tailwind, no Bootstrap. Do not restart the dev server.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT introduce new dependencies (no chart libs, no QR libs beyond the free image API). Do not rewrite existing architecture. Reuse glassmorphism CSS classes from index.css.
key_patterns: 1) All backend views use @api_view + @permission_classes decorators from DRF. 2) All views return JsonResponse (not DRF Response). 3) csrf_exempt on all mutation endpoints. 4) Frontend uses 'api' axios instance from src/services/api.js (baseURL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api). 5) CSS uses CSS variables --theme-accent, --text-primary, etc defined in :root and .theme-* classes. 6) glassmorphism: .glass-card class. 7) Buttons: .btn-clinical.primary or plain button.primary. 8) Font: JetBrains Mono for .font-monospace, Outfit for main. 9) Models: report_data on PathologyReport is JSON string of [{name,value,unit}] array. 10) _predict_using_ml returns Optional[float] currently — must be changed to Optional[dict]. 11) run_prediction view currently stores factors nowhere — factors should be added to JsonResponse but NOT to PredictionRecord model.
directory_structure: backend/medical/ — Django app with models.py, views.py, urls.py, services/ai_service.py, services/llm_provider.py, ml_models/{heart_attack_rf,diabetes_rf,cancer_rf}.pkl, migrations/. frontend/src/ — App.jsx (router+navbar+sidebar), index.css (all styles), services/api.js, pages/{Profile,Upload,Dashboard,...}.jsx, pages/profile/{ProfileIdentity,MedicalVault,RiskAssessments,PillBox}.jsx, pages/dashboard/{PatientDashboard,GuestDashboard,DoctorDashboard}.jsx, components/{AIChatbot,InteractiveMap}.jsx, context/SidebarContext.jsx
